items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: me and Keg Cake, me and Keg Cake --

ctx.x: You mean Max wouldn't tell them in front.

No, he just walked in and say, you know, and so that -- but then he got wind of this, and he -- and he started telling them in front, and then they started -- so we was going all the way down through to Virginia and couldn't get a place, couldn't get a motel.

So finally I said to Max, I said, 'Look, Max, let's go on into the town, and you take us to a certain -- to the railroad tracks, and I'll find a place. So we went into this town. I forget which town it was. It's down at one of the colleges, you know.
